title: 100 Synonyms for Very: Stop Saying Very Good, Very Big, Very Bad | Listen and Repeat
description:
100 synonyms for very: stop saying very good, very big, very bad and 17 more "very" phrases. For each one you get five stronger words, each in a short example sentence, to listen to and repeat.

How to practice: you hear the stronger word, for example "huge" instead of "very big". Then you hear it in a sentence. Say the sentence out loud in the pause, then listen and say it again.

The 100 words

Instead of "very big"
huge, giant, enormous, massive, vast

Instead of "very good"
excellent, superb, fantastic, outstanding, brilliant

Instead of "very happy"
thrilled, delighted, overjoyed, ecstatic, elated

Instead of "very tired"
exhausted, drained, worn out, shattered, weary

Instead of "very bad"
terrible, awful, dreadful, horrible, atrocious

Instead of "very small"
tiny, minuscule, microscopic, miniature, compact

Instead of "very sad"
miserable, heartbroken, devastated, gloomy, down in the dumps

Instead of "very angry"
furious, livid, outraged, fuming, irate

Instead of "very beautiful"
gorgeous, stunning, breathtaking, exquisite, radiant

Instead of "very scared"
terrified, petrified, horrified, panic-stricken, scared stiff

Instead of "very important"
crucial, essential, vital, critical, paramount

Instead of "very interesting"
fascinating, captivating, gripping, intriguing, absorbing

Instead of "very cold"
freezing, icy, frozen, bitter, arctic

Instead of "very hot"
boiling, scorching, sweltering, baking, roasting

Instead of "very short"
brief, quick, fleeting, momentary, short-lived

Instead of "very clean"
spotless, immaculate, pristine, gleaming, squeaky clean

Instead of "very loud"
deafening, thunderous, ear-splitting, booming, piercing

Instead of "very difficult"
tough, demanding, grueling, arduous, punishing

Instead of "very rich"
wealthy, affluent, loaded, prosperous, filthy rich

Instead of "very surprised"
astonished, amazed, stunned, flabbergasted, astounded
